pool.text: Jim Bridger was likely the first explorer of European descent in the area.
Settlers led by Brigham Young founded Salt Lake City to escape persecution.
Great Salt Lake City replaced Fillmore as the territorial capital.
Congress prohibited slavery in all United States territories during the Civil War.
Fort Douglas was established to maintain Union allegiance during the Civil War.
St. Mark's Episcopal Cathedral was built in Salt Lake City.
The Utah Symphony Orchestra was founded and grew into a major orchestra.
KTVX 4 signed on the air as Utah's first television station.
Chinese businesses and residences were demolished although a historical marker was erected.
The Utah Arts Festival has been held annually with a high average attendance.
The Utah Jazz moved to Salt Lake City from New Orleans.
The Living Traditions Festival started in Salt Lake City.
The festival hosted at Area 51 started.
Damn These Heels film festival began in the city.
Salt Lake City was home to the Utah Starzz team.
Light rail transit returned to the city when the TRAX system opened.
The Blue Line light rail system opened in Salt Lake City.
The local Pagan community celebrated Salt Lake City Pagan Pride Day.
The city hosted the Winter Olympics and later planned another.
A Public Safety Building housing police and fire employees opened.
